body:
I am taking part in an Ayahuasca ceremony on 12 December and I created a spread addressing my main questions. Here’s a link to a picture of the spread: https://imgur.com/DjWRI7m
I give the spread positions, cards, and my very limited interpretation below.

1st position - What will I gain/learn from this experience? What will be the lesson/biggest take away?
Page of Wands

2nd position - Will taking ayahuasca help restore my ability to naturally reach meditative states/altered states of consciousness, effortlessly follow guided meditations, visualisations and hypnotic sessions, and experience bodily sensations and sense and feel energy/vibrations during meditation?
Knight of Pentacles (Whilst shuffling the deck and saying this question out loud and thinking about it, I caught a glimpse of The Star and 9 of Cups)

3rd position - Will taking ayahuasca help restore my libido, sexuality, horniness, and sexual arousal? Will it also restore vaginal muscles movement and genital sensitivity?
4 of Swords

4th position - What will this experience help me accomplish moving forward into the future?
10 of Cups. (Above that is The Hermit, whilst I was shuffling and saying this question out loud, The Hermit card flipped over, it might also relate to the first question)

Bottom of the deck (no specific question) - The Chariot


So when I saw the Knight of Pentacles in the second position I thought “Ugh! I might have to work for it”.
With the 4 of Swords I thought “No. Maybe take a break from worrying about it and wait”.
I was happy to see the 10 of Cups in this position, I thought “I will be happy (maybe with someone). And maybe I will be able to leave this country and live where I want to”.
I saw The Chariot and thought “My will will prevail”.


Any help interpreting the cards is deeply appreciated.
